x: Greetings have been received from Edmund Donovan, O.B.E., of New York, who was a very active Club member in 1912, and subsequent years. It is possible that he may be present at our Club Track and Field Championships at Hurlingham in June.

It was a great pleasure to us that ALBERT was fit enough to attend our Track Championships just over a year ago and meet an old club friend in Edmund Donovan from New York; and that in January last he was present at Wimbledon to present the MACHER Shield to the winner.
A letter of good wishes and a cheque for $ 25 has been received from Edmund P. Donovan, O.B.E., now of New York; and a member of the Club way back in 1911.

Through the gossamer veils of memory come the gentleness of Evelyn Stimpson and the pleasure of seeing Wynn Shepherd, of the American Belgravian Edmund Donovan and his wife, who flew in, specially for the occasion, from New York.

Edmund Donovan had to cut short his visit to the U.K. last year. His wife, Daye, wrote to us on his behalf after he had had an operation on his hip; however, come Christmas we find him sending greetings in his own handwriting with a hope to visit us again this year.
"One of our oldest members, Edmund Donovan, O.B.E. was recently over here from New York where he lives. He was a Belgravian before the 1914-18 War, afterwards he went to the U.S.A.
As a token of Edmund Donovan's esteem for Belgrave Harriers Daye presented our President with a cheque for about £1,200. It was a gesture that the Club deeply appreciates.
We are sorry to learn of the death of Edmund Donovan in late November. He was one of the our oldest members and a Vice-President.
